nodes.title: Average open-circuit voltage 3.80 V/cell (LiHV nameplate, D-174)
nodes.text: Mean OCV between 100 % and 20 % state of charge
nodes.basis: LiPo OCV curve averages ~3.80 V over 100-20 %; 3.70 V nameplate is used (conservative ~3 %). Rule: the pack's nameplate cell voltage. For an LiHV pack (4.35 V/cell full) the nameplate is 3.80 V (15.2 V / 4) and the pack trade uses it per candidate (E2 D-168). D-174: battery.v_nom is 15.2 (Gens Ace Shorty, LiHV), so the budget chains carry 3.80 V/cell (E2 final re-run 2026-11-14)

nodes.title: OCV at 20 % charge 3.73 V/cell
nodes.text: Resting voltage at the 20 % reserve line
nodes.basis: typical LiPo rest curve (3.73-3.75 V at 20 %); measured on the first discharge test (T-E2-CAPACITY)

nodes.title: Cell-group resistance 3.8 mOhm at 25 degC = the IR acceptance line (D-174)
nodes.text: DC internal resistance per series cell group (2 parallel cells, 4S2P) of the Gens Ace Shorty; the pack is accepted only at or under this value, so every chain runs on the acceptance line
nodes.basis: E2 final re-run 2026-11-14: hover heat and cold sag close at 3.8 mOhm per cell group (hot landing 50 degC line, CL-E2-PACK-T-END). params battery.pack carries the same line. hobby packs measure 2.5-5 mOhm/cell new; C labels (130C) are not physical. Measure with a load step (T-E2-IR)

nodes.title: Cold-pack resistance factor 1.5
nodes.text: Cell resistance at 10 degC = 1.5 x the 25 degC value
nodes.basis: LiPo IR roughly doubles from 25 to 0 degC; 10 degC is the bottom of params env.ambient_design_c (March-April 07:00 at RFS). Keeping packs in the car cabin removes most of it

nodes.title: Hover wind/control factor 1.10 (pessimistic)
nodes.text: Hover power in 5 m/s wind with station-keeping activity = 1.10 x calm hover power
nodes.basis: 16 deg lean at 5 m/s needs T/cos = 1.04 W; P ~ T^1.5 gives +6 %; +4 % for attitude-control activity. Replace with the twin's logged hover current

nodes.title: Mission profile timings
nodes.text: Ground 180 s at avionics power; climb and descent between 0 and 50 m AGL at 2.0 / 1.0 m/s; forward and back transitions 10 s at 1.4 / 1.3 x hover power (pessimistic 20 s each); hover hold at 50 m before the transition = requirements.hover_time_min x 60 - climb - descent - landing hover 30 s - requirements.goaround_hover_s (D-160: 3.0 min total hover-mode time = 180 - 25 - 50 - 30 - 40 = 35 s hold); the landing hover and the go-around are spent after the cruise and sit in the BATT_LOW landing need (CALC-E2-FAILSAFE); cruise to the reserve line
nodes.basis: R-TEST-ORDER transition at >= 50 m AGL; ArduPilot Q_PILOT_SPD_UP default 2.5 m/s, land 1 m/s; tailsitter pitch-over is a few seconds at high throttle (J1 evidence); doubled for the pessimistic case. Hover split per review/CLOSURE-ROUND-2026-11-14/A2.md s2.1 (D-160); landing hover 30 s includes the last 6 m at 0.3 m/s (Q_LAND_FINAL_ALT 6). Was a fixed 120 s hold with no go-around (E2 closure 2026-11-14)

nodes.title: Cruise mass scaling, circuit factor and independent cross-check model
nodes.text: The cruise power LEVEL is B1's as-designed simulation (CL-B1V-CRUISE-P-GATE at the 2.6 kg gate; CL-B1V-CRUISE-P-PESS at A3's predicted mass CL-A3-MASS-PREDICTED; level flight, avionics included). This E2 drag model (CD0 0.0593, x1.3 pessimistic, e from params, eta_prop 0.47 / 0.35, eta_motor 0.72, trim 1.05) only scales B1's power from B1's reference mass to the budget mass (the pessimistic value up to the gate), and is reported as a cross-check. The turning (circuit) factor 1.05 multiplies B1's level-flight power
nodes.basis: K09 sizing.json CD0 build-up; REVIEW section 4 corrected efficiencies; circuits inside one RFS sub-field spend about half the time in 30 deg banks (induced drag x1.33). CR-E2-08: B1 owns cruise power; E2 follows B1's claims through the proof chain (re-run this script after every B1 re-run)

nodes.title: Charge profile
nodes.text: CC at min(1C, charger W / 16.8 V) to ~85 % state of charge, then CV for 20 min
nodes.basis: standard LiPo CC-CV; 1C is the maker's normal charge rate for hobby packs

nodes.title: Energy budget per phase, base case (sized mass)
nodes.equation: I = (Voc - sqrt(Voc^2 - 4 R P)) / (2 R) per phase ; Ah = I t ; P_cruise = P_B1(gate) x circuit x P_E2(m) / P_E2(gate) ; t_cruise = (C - 0.2 C - sum Ah_fixed) / I_cruise

nodes.title: Energy budget per phase, pessimistic (2.6 kg gate)
nodes.equation: as base (cruise level x k, k = (E1 17 m/s point + avionics + turbulator) / B1 gate, D-174), with m = gate, C x 0.92, R x 1.5 (10 degC), P_hover x 1.10, P_cruise = B1 as-designed pessimistic (CL-B1V-CRUISE-P-PESS at A3 predicted mass) x P_E2,pess(gate) / P_E2,pess(m_pred) x circuit, 20 s transitions

nodes.title: Bus voltage at the 100 A limiter vs pack state; bracket on the thrust factor
nodes.equation: V_bus = Voc - R I_lim (limiter binds when I_unlim(V) = n I_148 (V/14.8)^2 > I_lim) ; thrust factor worst/fresh bracketed by (V_w/V_f) (thrust prop. to power) and (V_w/V_f)^(2/3) (ideal rotor at fixed current) ; old rule (V/V_tab)^2 kept for the record (unlimited motor) ; bracket margin = min(f_E1 - lower, upper - f_E1)

nodes.title: F4 LiHV voltage backups [BATT_LOW_VOLT, BATT_CRT_VOLT, BATT_ARM_VOLT] V (F4 D-174)
nodes.text: 14.4 / 14.0 / 17.0 V = 3.60 / 3.50 / 4.25 V per cell, sag-compensated (BATT_FS_VOLTSRC 1); full charge 4.35 V/cell
nodes.basis: review/CLOSURE-ROUND-2026-11-14/F4.md section D-174 table (F4 EST, asked E2 to confirm: CR-F4-59). The 20 % OCV is ASM-E2-OCV-20; a LiHV cell rests at or above the LiPo value at the same charge, so using 3.73 V is the conservative end for the LOW / CRT backups

nodes.title: F4 voltage backups against the mAh failsafes (they must fire later) and the arming line against full charge
nodes.equation: margin_low = OCV_20 - V_low / cells (the voltage backup sits below the resting voltage at the 20 % reserve, so the mAh trigger fires first) ; margin_crt = V_low / cells - V_crt / cells ; margin_arm = V_full_cell - V_arm / cells (a fresh 4.35 V/cell pack passes the arming check)

nodes.title: Pack self-heating over the pessimistic mission, cold and hot mornings
nodes.equation: Q = sum(I^2 R t) over phases ; dT = Q / (m c) (adiabatic, c = 1000 J/kg K) ; T_end = T_amb + dT ; cold: 10 degC, R x 1.5 ; hot: 30 degC, R x 1.0

nodes.title: Battery failsafe thresholds for the flight controller
nodes.equation: CRT_MAH = reserve C ; LOW_MAH = CRT + Ah(back-transition + descent + 60 s return cruise + 30 s landing hover + goaround_hover_s go-around at hover current, D-160), pessimistic currents, rounded up to 100 mAh ; the FC counts mAh used against BATT_CAPACITY = the pack's measured capacity (D-154; pessimistic pack = cap_frac x C), so BATT_LOW fires after (cap_frac C - LOW_MAH) used ; t_to_low = (cap_frac C - LOW_MAH - Ah before cruise) / I_cruise ; charge at touchdown after a QRTL from the far point = LOW_MAH - need

nodes.title: Sorties per test day and charge time
nodes.equation: sorties_window = floor(window / (t_flight + t_turn)) ; sorties = min(packs, window) (D-12: 2) ; window used = sorties t_flight + (sorties - 1) t_turn ; t_charge = (0.85 - 0.20) C / I_cc + t_cv ; I_cc = min(1C, P_chg / 16.8 V)

nodes.title: E1's worst/fresh thrust factor lies inside E2's physical bracket (D-35)
nodes.how: T-E1-STAND fresh and worst-state runs: measured thrust ratio between the measured bus-voltage ratio and its 2/3 power.
nodes.note: D-35 resolved: E2 adopts E1's station model (CL-E1-SAG-FACTOR, CL-E1-TW-WORST) as the one worst-state claim. The limiter binds in every pack state, so the pack current is fixed at the limiter and thrust follows power (lower bound, thrust ~ V) or the ideal rotor (upper, ~ V^(2/3)); E1 lies between. Retires CL-E2-SAG-F-WORST and CL-E2-TW-SAG-WORST (the (V/14.8)^2 rule counted the sag twice)

nodes.title: Unlimited pack current at 20 % charge, 10 degC (limiter still binds)
nodes.how: Same stand run with Q_M_BAT_CURR_MAX disabled for one 1 s punch (props on the stand only): pack current at full duty above the limiter. If it is not, the V^2 rule applies below the limiter and D-35 re-opens.

nodes.title: Named flight pack passes the pack trade (acceptance line, cruise to BATT_LOW at 17 m/s >= requirement, landing >= BATT_CRT, current, lead)

nodes.note: E2 closure 2026-11-14: re-defined. Was 'largest candidate passing A1 sized mass and the 20 % line', which no pack could pass because CL-A1-MASS-SIZED 2.64 kg sits above the 2.6 kg gate. The id is kept for the graph links. Value = the named pack's Ah if it passes all five criteria, else 0

nodes.title: BATT_CRT_MAH (critical: QLAND)
nodes.how: SITL and bench (props off): set BATT_CAPACITY to the measured capacity (D-154), inject current, confirm QLAND at this count.

nodes.title: BATT_LOW_MAH (low: QRTL)
nodes.how: Same bench test: QRTL at this count; landing then ends above BATT_CRT_MAH.

nodes.title: Cruise before BATT_LOW (QRTL) fires, pessimistic pack, counter = measured capacity, at B1's cruise point
nodes.how: SITL with the logged currents and BATT_CAPACITY = measured: QRTL must not trigger before requirements.cruise_time_min (3.5 min, D-160) of cruise.
nodes.note: What this measures: R-MISSION as flown. Minutes of cruise, after ground, climb, the hover hold and the forward transition, before the flight controller's mAh counter reaches BATT_LOW_MAH and commands QRTL, on the pessimistic pack (92 % of nameplate, cold, gate mass). The counter counts against BATT_CAPACITY = the pack's measured capacity (D-154), and BATT_LOW_MAH holds the energy to come back and land, one 40 s hover go-around (D-160) and the 20 % reserve. It is stricter than CL-E2-CRUISE-MIN-PESS*, which cruises to the 20 % line and keeps nothing for the return. Before D-154 the counter base was 6 500 mAh, which spent the reserve on a 92 % pack

nodes.note: Information (E2 closure 2026-11-14): the limit >= 0.556 kg was removed because it was the same test as CL-E2-SKU-MASS-MARGIN (accept - (551 + 5 g) >= 0), counted twice; that claim and CL-E2-PACK-LARGEST keep it. D-154: the pack pass line of record is A3's CL-A3-PACK-ACCEPT (carried pack + CL-A3-GATE-MARGIN - build overrun), read live, never typed in: 564.4 g on 2026-11-14, so <= 564 g that day (the 558 g of D-132 is retired). A3 may move it (D-155 package), so it is re-read on the weigh day. Limit = the SKU's listed maximum 0.556 kg: below it the named pack itself would fail acceptance

nodes.title: Flight pack mass carried in the budget (not yet weighed)

Pass: every pack <= CL-E2-PACK-ACCEPT-KG (= CL-A3-PACK-ACCEPT, 485.9 g when this script last ran; re-read on the weigh day); a pack above 0.424 kg (the listed maximum) is reported to A3 so the 550 g line is replaced; a pack above the acceptance line is returned (D-64; the Tattu fallback is not pre-approved).

nodes.title: Weigh and measure every pack on arrival
nodes.procedure: 1 g scale; calipers L x W x H incl. lead exit; one row per pack (E2-P1, E2-P2) in redesign/team/E2/pack_log.csv, then re-run this script and build_graph.py.

nodes.title: Discharge capacity test at 1C
nodes.procedure: Charger discharge mode is limited in power: discharge through the thrust stand at ~6.0 A to 3.5 V/cell under load, log mAh with the watt meter; pass >= 5.52 Ah (0.92 x 6.0 Ah; D-174 pack). Also log resting voltage at 100 / 50 / 20 % (LiHV backups, CL-E2-LIHV-BACKUP-*).

nodes.title: Pack resistance by load step
nodes.procedure: Thrust stand, one motor: rest voltage, then 20 A step; R = dV / dI after 2 s; repeat at 10 degC (pack 1 h in a fridge, bagged). Pass <= 3.8 mOhm per cell group (4S2P) at 25 degC (D-174 acceptance line; the hot-landing 50 degC line, CL-E2-PACK-T-END, holds only up to it).
